paper_title: Search for Axionlike-Particle-Induced Prompt gamma-Ray Emission from Extragalactic Core-Collapse Supernovae with the Fermi Large Area Telescope
notes: Combined observed 95% CL limit (blue solid 'Observed' curve) from Fig. 2 of the paper, file combined_limits_Mprog10_SN-Ib-mid-nest_default_jansson12.pdf in the arXiv e-print, extracted from the vector path (color RGB 0.031,0.290,0.570). Calibrated from tick strokes: x_pix=203.1+138.3*log10(m_a/neV), y_pix=136.5-93.9*log10(g/1e-11 GeV^-1); decade spacings 138.3px (x) and 93.9px (y). Cross-check: flat low-mass reach reproduces 2.63e-11 GeV^-1, matching the paper's headline g_agamma > (2.6+2.0-0.7)e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a < 3e-10 eV. Fiducial model: 10 M_sun progenitor, NiCo optical light-curve model, JF12 Galactic magnetic field. Limit is independent of m_a for m_a<~0.5 neV and degrades at higher mass as the photon-ALP conversion probability drops; the curve exits the top of the plotted frame (g=2e-10 GeV^-1) near m_a~4e-9 eV, where the last point is the frame-exit interpolation. Not a dark-matter search (prompt gamma-ray burst from SN Primakoff production/conversion), so no DM density assumed. The 68/95% expected/observed bands are not reported here; this is the median observed limit for P(N_SN,obs>0)=88.5%.
